title: About Devon Miller
intro: Staff software engineer with eight years of experience architecting distributed cloud systems and accessible frontend interfaces.
bioParagraphs: My work bridges the gap between infrastructure resilience and human-centric interface design. I believe software systems should be transparent, deterministic, and accessible to everyone by default.

Over my career, I have led technical delivery across fintech platforms, developer tooling ecosystems, and large-scale public sector interfaces. I prioritize Clean Architecture, thorough static verification, and lean web standards over fragile abstractions.

timeline.description: Directing core multi-tenant platform architecture, container sandboxing, and web accessibility standards across engineering squads.
Architected accessible, high-volume design systems and component libraries in TypeScript and Astro.
Developed full-stack web applications, REST APIs, and automated CI/CD pipeline automation.
Focused on software engineering principles, algorithms, and distributed systems.
